name: ODYSSEY Communications
summary: Brisbane ISP (ODYSSEY Communications, Fortitude Valley QLD; trading as Odyssey World Pty Ltd). One contiguous /22 in the 1997 IP Network Index (ODYSSEY-AU 203.11.104.0-203.11.107.255). odyssey.com.au captured from 6 Jun 1997; by 2000 the site was branded 'Welcome to Odyssey World' and advertised dial-up points of presence in Sydney and Brisbane. ISP-era captures end 2001; the domain had become a WordPress site by 2016.

events.details: Existing by 1997: allocated the contiguous /22 ODYSSEY-AU 203.11.104.0-203.11.107.255 (Fortitude Valley QLD) in the 1997 IP Network Index; odyssey.com.au captured by the Wayback Machine from 6 Jun 1997 (HTTP 200).
odyssey.com.au served 'Welcome to Odyssey World' (15 Jan 2000 capture), operated by Odyssey World Pty Ltd, advertising dial-up points of presence in Sydney and Brisbane.
